findings.text: blocking: the ten-minute memory figure samples the wrong process. The run's sampler (live-rss-sampler.py in the run directory) reads /proc/<pid>/status for the pid returned by subprocess.Popen(["uv", "run", "--no-sync", "llm-watch", "--live"]), and uv run forks the command rather than exec-ing it, so that pid is the uv launcher and llm-watch renders in a grandchild: measured on this node, uv run python -c 'sleep 6' gave the Popen pid an RSS of 29512 kB whose child carried a different pid (790), and the recorded plateau of 27472-27604 kB sits in that launcher range. A flat launcher footprint is constant by construction, so any growth in the live view would be invisible and the done_when's 'resident memory stays within 10%' is not asserted; re-measure against the renderer's own pid before this claim is relied on.

non-blocking: the pointer test swallows the superseded help test. The edit renames test_watch_help_does_not_name_the_superseded_record_default into test_watch_without_json_points_at_llm_watch and leaves the old body's docstring at line 53 as a bare string expression followed by its STALE_DEFAULT assertion, so the repository loses the named regression test, the pointer test now fails for two unrelated reasons, and the stranded docstring describes a check it no longer introduces; keep the help test as its own function beside the new one.

non-blocking: removing watch.watch_text breaks a file the node could not write. tests/test_agent_watch_cost.py:305, :960 and :967 still call watch.watch_text at head (git grep 63c68d7a), so the whole-tree suite is red at the landed revision even though the four gated files are green; the manifest records this under outside_scope, and it needs a follow-up node that owns that file to convert those call sites to watch_document or drop them, after which render_document/render_rail/render_cards/render_ledger_rows/_plain can also be retired.

non-blocking: the fragment states 119 samples 'once per refresh interval' over 590 s, but logs/llm-watch-live-rss.csv holds a 22.561 s gap between t=200.000 and t=222.561 and four samples sharing t=222.561-222.562 in one burst, so at most 115 distinct instants were sampled; neither the timestamps of the child's refreshes nor a 5 s refresh cadence is recorded anywhere, and logs/llm-watch-live-output.txt carries no per-render stamp from which a cadence could be read.
